boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 100 is a short ring-rotation board built around one moving empty pocket. Open the left side first, chase the gap to the top-right corner, and then use the cleared middle column to flush the final green slabs through the top and right exits.
landmarks: Block Out Level 100 is a short ring-rotation board built around one moving empty pocket.
Open the left side first, chase the gap to the top-right corner, and then use the cleared middle column to flush the final green slabs through the top and right exits.
The board mixes Green, Yellow, Orange and more.
The opening layout is a color-sort grid.
Clear matched tiles to finish the level.

quickTips: Keep the empty pocket moving. If it gets buried in the middle too early, the ring stalls.
The top-right corner should open before you try to cash the top-center green slab.
If the board feels stuck, look for the color with the cleanest path and use that to regain space.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Use the small gap on the left side of the ring to start the rotation.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Shift the top-row slabs so the empty pocket moves into the top-right corner.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Open the middle column once that top-right corner is clear.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Send the top-center green slab out through the top exit as soon as its lane opens.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Clear the right-side green slab next, then feed the remaining yellow slabs around the ring.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Finish with the last green blocks once the center is empty.

failurePoints: Dropping a slab into the middle before the empty pocket has rotated to the top-right corner.
Trying to clear the top-center green slab before the middle column is actually open.
